behavior: The host explicitly authorizes an exact taunt target and nonnegative threat floor; runtime validates same-room alive detectable hostility evidence, floors the persisted ledger, overrides current target to the admitted event, and suppresses duplicate/regressive ticks.
sources: existing world-owned threat ledger from CodeUpdate0168
explicit host observation/hostility authority boundary from CodeUpdate0162
assumptions: host supplies already-resolved taunt authorization and target validity
event IDs are stable within one snapshot
multiple admitted events resolve in stable event-ID order, with the last admitted event owning the override
safe_fallback: Unauthorized or invalid taunts do not mutate ledger or target; if no taunt is admitted, existing positive ledger ranking is retained.
runtime_impact: Adds exact taunt admission and persistent target override without defining native taunt formulas.
world_state_impact: NPC metadata threat ledger, target, monotonic taunt tick and compact audit counters.
